system.description: Engaging a target in conversation and winning a Mental Challenge subtly bonds their psyche to yours for one night per permanent Mental Trait you possess, divided by two (round down). The victim must bid an extra Trait in challenges whenever away from you or not furthering your goals, you gain five extra Traits when asserting authority over her via Dominate, Presence, Subterfuge, or Leadership, and she cannot regain Willpower Traits except in your presence.
system.duration: Nights equal to permanent Mental Traits / 2
